- Identity & Security — JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC, TOTP 2FA, Single Sign-On (SSO)
- Workflow Automation — IMAP email parsing, ETL pipelines, state machines, background job processing
- AI Integration — RAG engines, vector databases, LLM integration, OCR data extraction
